claims.source_quote_ar: وَجُعِلَ الْفِعْلُ الَّذِي بَعْدَهُ مُفَسِّرًا لَهُ، وَالْأَحْسَنُ أَنْ يَكُونَ التَّقْدِيرُ: بَاشِرُوا ذَلِكُمْ فَذُقُوهُ لِتَكُونَ الْفَاءُ عَاطِفَةً.

claims.claim_en: A verb that follows a preceding statement can serve to explain or be the consequence of that statement; thus 'فاتبعوني' can be read as explaining or resulting from the preceding clause (i.e., as an instruction consequent on what was said).
